_about: H6 Too hot, just right (docs/modes/clinic-design.md Q4 H6; contract docs/clinic-heal-api.md). The conversation game: the thermometer's reading, then the patient's answers, decide each step and when to stop. The patient's face never shows hot or cold (it would give the answer away); only the words do. A script of needs (+ warmer, - cooler) with 'physics': a wrong step makes the patient need one more the other way. Level 1 is three or four exchanges (not the design's one: one binary exchange is 50% blind); blind odds 1/2 x 1/2^(k-1) x the stop.

1.note: Three or four exchanges in either direction, then Done on just right. Every step is one tap-tap.

2.note: The reading comes with a count (Cold! trae blankets / Hot! fan, ba times); the count closes when the item is put down.

3.note: Plus the fan's speed on every too-hot step (fan, jaldi! / aastethi), judged by the rhythm of the taps.
